brief: Cold email before vs after Claude — reply rates, costs, and the exact stack.

slots.title: Stop sending
slots.description: See how Claude transforms cold email reply rates, slashes costs, and replaces the old outbound stack.

slots.title: Build lists
slots.description: Stop buying bloated contact databases that drain budget and stale fast.
slots.badText: You paid $20k/year for contact data that decayed in ninety days.
slots.goodText: Clay enriches leads with live data and AI scoring in one click.

slots.title: Write emails
slots.description: Ditch templates that scream mass blast and kill trust instantly.
slots.badText: Your team spent four hours daily tweaking mail-merge templates.
slots.goodText: Claude drafts unique icebreakers and angles for every single prospect.

slots.title: Reach the inbox
slots.description: Stop landing in spam because of shared IPs and sloppy setup.
slots.badText: Shared sending pools burned your domain reputation in weeks.
slots.goodText: Smartlead warms mailboxes and rotates domains automatically.

slots.title: Handle replies
slots.description: No more manual sorting or missed opportunities in messy inboxes.
slots.badText: SDRs manually tagged leads and missed hot replies until Monday.
slots.goodText: AI agents qualify intent, book meetings, and sync to your CRM.

slots.title: Cut costs
slots.description: Replace a bloated tech stack and headcount with lean AI systems.
slots.badText: Five tools and two full-time roles to keep campaigns running.
slots.goodText: One operator, three AI tools, and fully automated workflows.

slots.title: 10x reply rates
slots.description: Relevance beats volume when every line proves you did research.
slots.badText: You sent five hundred emails and prayed for ten replies.
slots.goodText: Claude researches prospects and writes relevant hooks at scale.

slots.body: Drop the expensive stack. Launch your Claude-powered outbound system this week.
